text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France decides officially to withdraw form the U.S.-led air force patrolling northern Iraq.
- America is disappointed with the French decision.
- Iraqi oil minister says in Ankara his country regrets the Turkish government's support of U.S.-led air operations in norhtern Iraq.
- Egypt accuses Iran of distablising its security.
- Editorial praises France for withdrawing from the U.S.-led air operations in northern Iraq and condemning Turkey for allowing the air force to use its airbases.
